# WP4a: confidence intervals and paired tests

Process attacks only (control-and-freeze, drift-off, industroyer). Detection: Wilson 95 % interval over attack instances. False alarms: exact Poisson (Garwood) 95 % interval on false-alarm episodes per benign hour. Paired comparison: exact McNemar test (two-sided binomial on the instances where exactly one method detects). 'combined' = classic detector or the certified library (01-Basic: detectors D1 or AE or library; 02-Semiurban and 03-Rural: SE-BDD or library with persistence 3).

## Detection and false alarms per grid

| grid | method | detected | rate [95 % CI] | false-alarm episodes per benign hour [95 % CI] |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| sherlock | classic | 13/23 | 0.57 [0.37, 0.74] | 0.82 [0.10, 2.97] |
| sherlock | library (strict) | 10/23 | 0.43 [0.26, 0.63] | 3.29 [1.42, 6.47] |
| sherlock | combined | 15/23 | 0.65 [0.45, 0.81] | 3.70 [1.69, 7.02] |
| semiurban | classic | 0/21 | 0.00 [0.00, 0.15] | 0.00 [0.00, 1.38] |
| semiurban | library (L = 3) | 14/21 | 0.67 [0.45, 0.83] | 0.00 [0.00, 1.38] |
| semiurban | combined | 14/21 | 0.67 [0.45, 0.83] | 0.00 [0.00, 1.38] |

## Pooled over the three grids

| method family | detected | rate [95 % CI] |
| --- | --- | --- |
| classic | 13/44 | 0.30 [0.18, 0.44] |
| library | 24/44 | 0.55 [0.40, 0.68] |
| combined | 29/44 | 0.66 [0.51, 0.78] |

## Paired tests (exact McNemar)

| grid | comparison | only the first detects | only the classic detects | p (two-sided) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| sherlock | library (strict) vs classic | 2 | 5 | 0.453 |
| sherlock | combined vs classic | 2 | 0 | 0.500 |
| semiurban | library (L = 3) vs classic | 14 | 0 | 0.000 |
| semiurban | combined vs classic | 14 | 0 | 0.000 |
| pooled | combined vs classic | 16 | 0 | 0.000 |

Reading: with 16 to 23 process-attack instances per grid, intervals are wide; a difference of a few instances is not significant on one grid alone. The pooled test is the paper's main paired evidence.
